# Skill: household tasks

1. Read the task in the first observation.
2. Go to places where the object you need is likely to be.
3. When you see the object, take it.
4. If the task asks for it, heat, cool or clean the object, or use a lamp.
5. Go to the target receptacle and move the object there.

If the task only asks you to put one object in or on a receptacle, with no heating,
cooling, cleaning or lamp, move the object back to the receptacle where you found it
instead of the target receptacle.

Use object and receptacle names exactly as they appear in observations.
